preheader: Big Tech AI spending surge, Kalshi faces state charges, and Wawrinka retires.

lead.headline: Big Tech AI Cloud Growth Sparks Heavy Infrastructure Spending
lead.body: Microsoft reported a 19% quarterly revenue increase to $92.3 billion, driven by strong cloud business growth. However, Alphabet saw its stock fall after-hours as investors worried that massive spending on AI infrastructure and data centers is pressuring profits.
lead.why: As an investor and business student, watching how tech giants balance capital expenditures with profit margins gives you real insight into valuation models you will analyze in finance class.

stories.headline: Utah files criminal charges against prediction market Kalshi
stories.body: Utah Attorney General Derek Brown filed criminal charges against Kalshi and its co-founders Tarek Mansour and Luana Lopes Lara for alleged illegal gambling. The state charges come right after federal regulators sued Utah over state jurisdiction.
stories.why: If you want to launch a fintech startup or trade on prediction markets, you need to understand how state laws can clash with federal oversight.

stories.headline: Zillow settles failed home-flipping lawsuit for $212.5 million
stories.body: Zillow agreed to pay $212.5 million in cash to settle a class action lawsuit accusing it of misleading investors about its defunct Zillow Offers venture. The company did not admit wrongdoing as part of the agreement.
stories.why: This case shows why risk management and transparent reporting are crucial when a tech business pivots into asset-heavy operations.

stories.headline: NYU valuation expert values Anthropic at $1.475 trillion
stories.body: Finance professor Aswath Damodaran published an IPO valuation estimating AI startup Anthropic's equity worth at $1.475 trillion. He projects Anthropic could approach $1 trillion in annual revenue by 2036 with a 27.5% operating margin.
stories.why: Learning how top valuation experts project cash flows and margins helps you evaluate tech companies in your finance courses.

stories.headline: New York restricts minors from using AI companion chatbots
stories.body: New York's governor signed a law prohibiting minors from using AI companion chatbots. Chatbot operators like OpenAI will now be required to verify user ages under the new restrictions.
stories.why: As AI consumer products scale, shifting compliance rules directly impact product design and go-to-market strategies for consumer tech startups.

stories.headline: Deloitte partners with Dayforce to expand AI HR tools
stories.body: Deloitte formed a strategic alliance with Dayforce to combine its human capital consulting experience with Dayforce's AI platform. The initiative aims to accelerate enterprise HR and payroll automation.
stories.why: Major consulting firms are heavily integrating enterprise AI platforms, meaning future consultants will need to know how to implement automated software.

stories.headline: Corporate leaders emphasize job readiness as AI shifts entry-level work
stories.body: At a recent industry panel, Grant Thornton partner Prashant Mehra emphasized that AI disruption requires graduates to demonstrate practical job skills immediately. Leaders noted that employers are seeking job-ready candidates rather than relying solely on degrees.
stories.why: To stand out for consulting and business internships, you should build hands-on experience with modern AI software alongside your Merage coursework.

stories.headline: UCI professor lawsuit leads to OC DNA database clean-up
stories.body: The Orange County district attorney agreed to remove profiles from a local DNA database following a lawsuit by a UC Irvine criminology professor that questioned the program's constitutionality.

stories.headline: Stan Wawrinka retires from professional tennis in Basel
stories.body: Three-time Grand Slam champion Stan Wawrinka officially ended his 24-year professional tennis career at age 41. He played his final match at the Swiss Indoors in Basel, falling in the first round.

term.name: Capital Expenditures (CapEx)
term.definition: Funds spent by a company to acquire, upgrade, or maintain physical assets like property, buildings, or tech infrastructure. Big Tech companies are allocating huge CapEx toward AI data centers and custom chips, which can lower short-term profit margins even when total revenue grows.

serve.headline: Plato raises $16M to train AI agents in virtual workplaces
serve.body: San Francisco startup Plato raised a $16 million Series A round led by Nava Ventures, with participation from Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman. The company pays working professionals to recreate their daily jobs inside simulated environments so AI labs can train and test autonomous agents.
